comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Created using Sophia points obtained from Legacy theme discoveries. Requires Transmutation Alchemy Equipment or Complex Alchemy Equipment furniture. Recipe:

Base item: Book of Ennead accessory
Handicrafts/Alchemy R11
Sophia points consumed per production: 250

Ingredients:
Asclepius' Medicated Bath x20
Ventus Reduction x10
The Sun's Gemstone x1
20% chance of success

As with all Transmutation Alchemy recipes, Book of Uroboros items work fine. Sadly, Book of the Wingless Dragon do not. Stats:

Unlock +2
Alchemy +2
Astronomy +2
EX Effect: Special Goods Production Rate Up R4

Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Update/20SevenWonders
